name: Flash Jutsu
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ninja 9th, secret technique class feature.

Benefit(s): You can select one secret technique you possess which requires a swift action to activate; one per round, you can increase the jutsu cost of that secret technique by 1 to activate it as a free action.
